description: This file implements a NotesService class for managing notes via HTTP API calls, providing methods to list, get, create, update, and delete notes, likely in an Angular application.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: Angular injectable service for performing CRUD operations related to notes via HTTP requests.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of notes, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a single note identified by its id.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note with the provided payload.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by its id.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a note by id, returning true on success.
